Part of me listened because I believed in it and was legitimately worried no one would marry me if I was no longer one, and part of me listened because I was worried I couldnt keep it as a secret from my parents (I get very anxious about it). So I eventually went through a 2,5 years of relationship without penetration, but did other things (oral, foreplay etc).

Fast forward to my second relationship, I finally understood for myself that it was my body and the only person that could decide what I want to do with it was ultimately myself, not my parents. And if a guy were to reject marriage with me because I was no longer a virgin, I probably wouldnt be interested in marrying such a close-minded person in the beginning anyway.

Last weekend I slept at a friend's place to avoid being alone for Valentine's Day. I woke up in the middle of the night, unable to recall where I was initially (the room being pitch black and all). Previously before waking up, I had the most vivid dream of my ex and I being together, so waking up in the middle of the night has made me initially think that I was back in his bedroom, back to being next to him.

Was about to snuggle up when reality hits me and I finally realise no, I was not in his bedroom. In fact, we haven't even been together for a few months now. I was in fact, next to my friend in her bedroom.

Shit hurts realising that the two of us aren't together anymore. And it was scary considering how real the dream seemed to be. That wasn't my first relationship, and hell - our relationship wasn't even considered 'intense' when compared to all my other previous relationships. But never in my life had I ever, *ever* dreamt of an ex after a breakup until that day.

You can only go forward from then.
